critical_code_review_comments: data_verifier.py: clean architecture with 542 lines — well within file size guidelines
Dual-source architecture verified: Kite primary (8s timeout), yfinance fallback, parallel asyncio.gather
compute_vix_theta_decay formula: uses Black-Scholes ATM theta approximation: Θ = entry×σ/(2×√(T×252)); VIX scale=1.1 for 7<days<=21 and 1.25 for days<=7
Dynamic target revision T2 calculation: when both Trigger 1 AND Trigger 2 fire, the higher T2 wins (max of both); important behavioral note — india_vix=None is treated as 'calm' (not zero VIX risk)
NSE_HOLIDAYS 2026: 10 entries including all major national holidays; 2026-04-06 correctly excluded
FNOGenerateResponse: 3 new fields (no_signals_alert, market_regime, market_session) all Optional — backward compatible
ThetaModel= tag not visible in live signals at market close (no signals generated), but code logic is verified via source inspection
server.py is 6391 lines — significantly over 700 line guideline — recommend refactoring into separate modules (e.g., fno_logic.py, portfolio_logic.py, trading_helpers.py)
